name: RUNX1 partner transcriptional co-repressor 1

function.text: RUNX1T1 encodes protein CBFA2T1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor binding. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Myeloid sarcoma; Acute myeloid leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
